title: Syrian-Style Grilled Flatbread
description: A flavorful and crispy flatbread, inspired by Syrian cuisine, perfect for grilling and serving with a variety of toppings.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Brush the flatbread with olive oil on both sides.
Season the flatbread with salt and sprinkle with garlic and rosemary.
Grill the flatbread for 2-3 minutes per side, or until crispy and slightly charred.
Remove from heat and let cool for a few minutes.
